overview: We look at what your items sell for on eBay, using your own sales and public sold listings, then at what you keep after fees and shipping. We suggest prices where you are too low or too high, set Best Offer auto-accept and decline rules, and plan sale events with eBay's own markdown tools. You get a pricing sheet you can reuse, and we apply changes only after you approve them.

faq: Where does the price data come from?
From your own eBay sales and from sold listings that anyone can see on eBay. We do not scrape other sites or buy data lists. We note where the sample is small, so you can weigh it.
Do you change prices without asking?
No. You approve each change list first. After that we update the listings in bulk and record the old prices in a sheet, so you can go back if you wish.
How do Best Offer rules work?
You choose a lowest price you will accept and a price below which offers are declined automatically. We calculate those from your costs, set them on each listing and test a couple of offers.
Can you make a sale on eBay?
Yes, using eBay's markdown manager and promotions in your account, with real start and end dates. We do not show invented original prices to make an offer look larger.
